clips.title: The story
paras: King Terenas Menethil II was the venerable sovereign of Lordaeron who ruled for over five decades and forged the original Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. Renowned as a wise and diplomatic leader, he shielded humanity from the initial Horde invasion and sheltered the young Prince Varian Wrynn. His tragic murder by his corrupted son, Prince Arthas, directly triggered the collapse of Lordaeron to the Scourge.

When refugees from Stormwind arrived in the north led by Sir Anduin Lothar, King Terenas Menethil II answered their call. Convening the monarchs of the fractured human kingdoms alongside envoys from Ironforge and Quel'Thalas, Terenas orchestrated the formation of the Alliance of Lordaeron. Rather than seizing military command for himself, he wisely nominated Lothar as supreme commander, uniting humanity's kingdoms for the first time in millennia to triumph over the Old Horde.
